notes: No Architect brief was on disk for mission 92 (only the draft was handed to this pass); fence_size/unfenced_words are eyeballed, not brief-checked. Both counted as callbacks, not new landings. உன்/உனக்கு (nee-register) in the cousin's lines is correct, not a register slip — dialect.md's neenga-default carves out close cousins/siblings for nee, and this is an established close cousin.
